description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join a technical team building detection models and products for fraud, identity, and trust and safety. You will own problems end to end, from analyzing signals and developing models to delivering tools that help fraud analysts make decisions.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and ship detection models and the systems and products around them.

 - Evaluate model and system performance honestly, including identifying failure modes.

 - Work directly with trust and fraud teams to turn evidence into decisions and usable workflows.

 - Improve defenses as adversaries adapt to detection systems.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Technical experience in at least one area: computer vision or image forensics, speech or audio modeling, video or temporal analysis, ML infrastructure, evaluation or calibration, fraud, identity or trust and safety systems, or full-stack product engineering.

 - Experience owning a technical problem end to end and building and shipping detection models, supporting systems, or products.

 - Experience evaluating systems or models, identifying failure modes, and iterating as adversaries adapt.

 - Experience working with trust and fraud teams to translate evidence into decisions and product workflows.


LOCATION

New York, United States. Work arrangement was not specified.
